exposure: Women with only previous vaginal deliveries
Women with one previous caesarean section
outcome: Failed trial of vaginal birth after a cesarean
cohort: 870 women at two major tertiary maternity centers in Enugu, Nigeria
finding: Women with one previous caesarean section had a significantly higher risk of repeat caesarean section, placenta praevia, labor dystocia, intrapartum hemorrhage, primary postpartum hemorrhage, blood transfusion, and newborn special care admission compared to women with previous vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Women with one previous caesarean section had a significantly higher risk of repeat caesarean section.
